text:
Feta pasta:
-preheat oven to 425

- cut up tomatoes and place in glass container 
- crush 2/3 cloves of garlic over tomatoes 
- add oil to cover tomatoes (eyeball it) 
- add red pepper flakes, basil, pepper, (can do small amount of garlic powder)
-mix
- put feta block in middle of glass 
-pour some oil and red pepper flakes on top of feta 
- put glass into oven set at 425 for 30 mins
- make pasta
-halfway through cooking smash tomatoes a bit
-when done, mix feta with Tomatoes and add pasta to sauce 
-serve immediately 
Enjoy!!!!
